thesis: The morning thesis holds. The 2026-11-05 beat-and-raise (revenue +25.5% YoY, FY guide raised) and the 2026-11-09 William Blair upgrade still drive the stock. There is no new news or filing, and price made a higher low (52.28) and pushed to 56.35, just under the 56.38 52-week high, to sit at 54.93, still above SMA20 (49.9). Nothing broke, but price has moved away from the entry. At 54.93, reward/risk to the 62.5 target is about 0.9, so this stays a small, pullback-only long. The entry zone is cut from the pre-close technical card's [52.5, 54.0] to [52.28, 52.7], from today's 52.28 low up to the 52.7 morning cap, where reward/risk is about 1.56. Stop 46.4 is unchanged, and the target moves from 62.4 to the card's updated 62.5 (52-week high 56.38 plus 2xATR 3.09).
invalidation: A daily close below 46.4 (under the 46.63 swing low), or a close back under the SMA20 (~49.9) on rising volume.
key_risks: Today's push to 56.35 was rejected just under the 56.38 52-week high, so a double-top or a retest of the 49-50 area is possible before any breakout
At the current 54.93, reward/risk is about 0.9, so a fill above 52.7 would break the setup's math
